exposure: Operative reports with no errors vs. reports with major errors vs. reports with minor errors
Training level of resident physicians (PGY 1, PGY 2, PGY 3/4)
outcome: Incidence of documentation errors in cesarean operative reports
Type of documentation error (major or minor)
cohort: 100 resident physicians completing cesarean operative reports
finding: A high incidence of clinically significant documentation errors was observed in cesarean operative reports completed by resident physicians, with major errors decreasing and minor errors remaining consistent with increasing training level.
